scope: Deterministic effect-inert evaluation of whether explicitly declared authority, autonomy, consequence, novelty and monitoring evidence satisfy a minimum verifiability burden before any downstream authorization path may consider the request.
core_invariant: Capability must never outrun verifiability. An eligible result is evidence of minimum gate satisfaction only and is never authorization, a capability, delegation, credential, currentness proof, policy decision or effect admission.

risks: eligible result treated as execution authorization
decision cached as a reusable bearer grant
adapter bypasses the live policy or capability path
low consequence label used to hide high effective authority
high autonomy receives a low monitoring burden
lease duration remains broad while authority or autonomy rises
controls: monitorability baseline is the strongest of consequence, authority and autonomy floors
lease ceiling is the most restrictive of consequence, authority and autonomy ceilings
authority and autonomy are independently bounded from 0 through 4
novelty escalates from the already strongest assurance floor

risks: novel environment, tool, model, objective or counterparty omitted to reduce monitorability burden
external agent interaction declared without counterparty novelty
acting agent presented as independent monitor
acting agent presented as independent evaluator
high-authority or self-modifying request proceeds without independent scrutiny
controls: independence requirements are explicit output facts
self-modification requires independent monitor and evaluator

risks: stale identity treated as current
revoked or stale delegation treated as current
unbound monitoring facts substituted into another request
controls: policy binding digest is included in decision digest

risks: self-modification proceeds with nominal rollback that was never tested
rollback_tested asserted while rollback_available is false
controls: self-modification clamps max lease ceiling to 15000 ms

risks: caller supplies a longer lease
novel or self-modifying request inherits an unbounded duration
controls: consequence, authority and autonomy profiles jointly constrain lease ceilings
self-modification clamps the ceiling to 15000 ms

risks: decision or evidence projection modified after evaluation
requirements lowered without changing provenance

known_nonclaims: v0 does not verify signatures, identity proofs, delegation proofs, currentness checkpoints or policy digests itself.
v0 does not infer novelty from model reasoning, telemetry or prose.
v0 does not identify whether a claimed monitor or evaluator is truly independent.
v0 does not grant execution authority, delegation or policy permission.
v0 does not mint, revoke, consume or persist capability leases.
v0 does not integrate with chain-of-thought or activation monitoring.
v0 does not implement an RSI promotion or self-modification workflow.
v0 does not perform network, filesystem, credential, tool or runtime effects.
next_gates: bind verified currentness and policy evidence into the gate input adapter
implement separately reviewed capability lease issuance and revocation
implement monitor/evaluator identity and independence verification
integrate only after exact-head adversarial and production effect-path review
